Who I am

About Me

I'm Suhel Khan, an electrical engineering graduate from Uttar Pradesh. I completed my Diploma in Electrical Engineering at Integral University, Lucknow in 2026 with First Division with Honours.

I am currently working as a Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) at BA PRERNA from October 2026. In 2025, I completed an industrial internship at a 33/11 kV substation. I also have 6+ years of practical knowledge of domestic and residential electrical wiring.

I'm looking for an position where I can apply my electrical engineering knowledge, develop my technical skills and contribute to the growth of the organization while continuously learning.
